objective: Audit and complete the Seed Pod P0 kernel in memory_seed/core.py: root resolution, promotion/reference integrity, lifecycle preservation, retired-state guards, and recoverable update transactions. Implement only demonstrable gaps, add focused tests, and leave public adapters unchanged.

project_context.project_type_and_purpose: Memory Seed is a local-first Markdown authority for file-reading agents. Seed Pods add root-governed nested runtimes while the root remains the discovery and control center.
project_context.relevant_subsystem: The checkpoint implements runtime discovery, exact pod decision sources, adoption, detachment, retirement, reference audit, and a pending-journal root update transaction in memory_seed/core.py.
project_context.task_fit: This branch owns the coupled kernel because promotion, lifecycle, and update safety share one module and cannot safely be assigned to concurrent writers.
project_context.downstream_use: The orchestrator will review this kernel before combined validation. Adapter and fixture workers rely on checkpoint interfaces; report any necessary interface change explicitly.
non_goals: Do not implement P1 federated retrieval, edit CLI or MCP adapters, change governance documents, merge, push, release, or widen file ownership.

validation: python -X utf8 -m pytest -q tests/test_core_misc.py tests/test_project_lifecycle.py tests/test_seed_pod_core.py
